scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=server && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src='web/dist';const dst='server/dist/public';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('✓ Copied web/dist to server/dist/public')}"
